content.text:
Both pieces are in `lib/`. `compileTrust` in `lib/utils.js` turns the setting into a predicate, and `lib/application.js` handles the inheritance by mounted sub-apps. I read `defaultConfiguration` in `lib/application.js` and found the `compileTrust` definition only by grep, so I haven't read its body.

- **Normalizing the setting:** `compileTrust` in `lib/utils.js:194` is the function that converts the boolean, hop count, address list or function into a predicate. `app.set` in `lib/application.js` calls it when the `'trust proxy'` setting changes (line 371) and stores the result as `'trust proxy fn'`.
- **Inheritance by sub-apps:** `defaultConfiguration` sets `'trust proxy'` to `false` and marks it as a default with a symbol. Its `mount` handler (lines 109–115) then deletes the sub-app's own `'trust proxy'` and `'trust proxy fn'`. It does this only if the symbol is still set, meaning the sub-app never overrode the value, and the parent has a `'trust proxy fn'`. The sub-app's settings then fall through to the parent's through the prototype chain set up at line 121.
